agent_notes: Normal TLS verification reached the managed proxy and failed with the exact self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected search and official domains.

The official education and admissions pages enumerate seven degree programmes and five TSU short-term certificate programmes for 2026-27. Separate ADO/ADCO, ACABC, drone/RPTO and officer/employer training pages describe training activities rather than additional academic degree, diploma or certificate catalogue entries, so they were excluded.
The TSU pages do not explicitly state numeric duration or eligibility; those fields remain null. No doctoral programme appears in the official education or admissions catalogue.

Two BBA records are retained because the official catalogue lists distinct AKTU-affiliated and University-of-Lucknow-affiliated BBA programmes with separate approved intakes; course_id distinguishes them.
